summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd., a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes standard financial statements, management discussion and analysis, CEO and CFO certifications, and a consent of qualified person. No special-situation corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing is purely a periodic financial report with no transactional or extraordinary corporate action.
